column2: [intro]
In my cup, it loves to play,
Teasing me and brightening my day,
Tea, a brew with a whimsical flair,
Each sip gives a thrill, beyond compare!
Tea, it never seems to entice,
Yet it's so good, oh what a surprise!
A touch of sugar, a dash of cream,
Tea, the trickster of my dream!
When I sip just one, I crave more,
It teases me, leaves me wanting more,
Tea, the rascal that stirs up a storm,
In my life, it’s my charm, my norm!
Tea, it never seems to entice,
Yet it's so good, oh what a surprise!
A touch of sugar, a dash of cream,
Tea, the trickster of my dream!
[ solo ]
Tea, it never seems to entice,
But I adore it, it’s my vice!
A bit of zest, a pinch of cheer,
Tea, the trickster I hold dear!
[outro]
